title: 沉管水下對接與止水~Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing
focus: 沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障~Immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers
summary: 本課以沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障為主線，從端面姿態與初始接觸與主密封壓縮與反力曲線建立系統邊界，再把溫度伸縮與軸向位移、剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心連到屏障獨立性與交接檔案。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers. It begins with End-face attitude and initial contact and Primary-seal compression and reaction curves, links Thermal expansion and axial movement and Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact, and ends with Barrier independence and handover records. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 端面姿態與初始接觸~End-face attitude and initial contact
units.title: 端面姿態與初始接觸~End-face attitude and initial contact
units.mechanism: 接頭兩端面並非只需中心對準，偏航、俯仰和翹曲會使密封圈局部先接觸。第一接觸點承受的壓縮可能遠大於平均值，因而幾何差應沿整個周邊呈現；剛體角差模型只識別不均勻性，不能給出橡膠反力分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩端面共同座標的周邊點雲與接觸順序；若出現中心線合格但端面角差使密封一側過壓而另一側未接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Coincident centers do not ensure matching end faces: yaw, pitch and warping create early local seal contact. The first contact can compress far more than the average, so map mismatch around the perimeter. A rigid-angle model identifies nonuniformity but cannot determine rubber reaction distribution. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare perimeter point clouds in common coordinates with the sequence of contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If acceptable centerline alignment conceals excessive compression on one seal side and a gap on the other, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線~Primary-seal compression and reaction curves
units.title: 主密封壓縮與反力曲線~Primary-seal compression and reaction curves
units.mechanism: Gina 類主密封利用端面壓縮建立接觸，但空心斷面與材料非線性使反力不會簡單正比壓縮率。製造商試驗曲線應對應實際斷面和溫度，接縫、轉角及長期鬆弛另行評估；幾何壓縮率只能作版本與尺寸核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將周邊壓縮量與相符斷面試驗曲線及材料批次比對；若出現借用不同斷面曲線高估接觸反力，局部水壓超過有效密封能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A Gina-type primary seal develops contact through end compression, but hollow geometry and nonlinear rubber prevent reaction from scaling directly with compression ratio. Match manufacturer tests to the profile and temperature and assess corners, splices and relaxation separately. A geometric ratio checks dimensions and configuration only. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter compression with matching profile tests and material batches. If using another profile curve overstates contact reaction and leaves local water pressure beyond effective sealing capacity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. units.anchor: 壓差合攏與受力邊界~Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries
units.title: 壓差合攏與受力邊界~Pressure-assisted closure and load boundaries
units.mechanism: 接合階段內外壓差對封閉投影面產生軸向合力，經管節、接頭與支承形成平衡。計算面積應是壓差實際作用的有效面，不能混用水下面積或密封橡膠面積；摩擦、姿態和臨時構造使實際位移不能只由壓力推得。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照壓力分區圖、端面位移與接頭受力路徑；若出現漏列與外水連通的腔室，錯算有效壓差及合攏力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~During joining, pressure difference over a closed projected area produces axial force balanced through the element, joint and supports. Use the actual pressure-boundary area rather than submerged surface or rubber contact area. Friction, attitude and temporary works prevent pressure alone from predicting displacement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare pressure-zone diagrams, end-face displacement and joint load paths. If an omitted chamber connected to external water produces the wrong pressure difference and closure force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 次級密封與膜面荷載~Secondary seals and membrane loading
units.title: 次級密封與膜面荷載~Secondary seals and membrane loading
units.mechanism: Omega 類次級密封容許接頭相對位移，並提供與主密封不同的水密屏障。壓力乘跨距是每單位長度的橫向合力，不是膜張力；張力還取決於鼓出幾何、邊界固定和材料變形，夾具與角部不能從均勻薄膜模型略去。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把次級膜鼓出形狀、夾具位移與壓差試驗結果連結；若出現把橫向合力誤當膜張力，漏估夾持區剝離與角部應變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~An Omega-type secondary seal accommodates relative movement and forms a barrier distinct from the primary seal. Pressure times span gives transverse resultant per unit length, not membrane tension. Tension also depends on bulging geometry, restraints and material deformation; clamps and corners require separate assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate secondary-membrane bulge, clamp movement and differential-pressure tests. If treating transverse resultant as tension misses clamp peeling and corner strain, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移~Thermal expansion and axial movement
units.title: 溫度伸縮與軸向位移~Thermal expansion and axial movement
units.mechanism: 管節溫度改變可能透過接頭釋放位移，也可能因基床摩擦和相鄰約束累積軸力。自由伸縮是假想無拘束上限情境之一，不能同時又假定全拘束應力；維護判讀須對應量測溫度與實際滑移邊界，分開季節變化和永久漂移。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管節溫度、接頭軸向開度及長期位置趨勢；若出現季節開度被誤判永久沉陷，或永久漂移被季節平均掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Element temperature changes can release movement at joints or accumulate force through bedding friction and neighboring restraints. Free expansion is a hypothetical unrestrained case and cannot simultaneously imply full-restraint stress. Relate monitoring temperature to slip boundaries to separate seasonal changes from permanent drift. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare element temperature, axial joint opening and long-term position trends. If seasonal opening is mistaken for settlement or averaging conceals permanent drift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角~Differential settlement and joint rotation

This example assumes one rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor, so its chord inclination equals relative joint rotation. If both sides rotate, use their slope difference instead. Element bending and shear-key restraints also redistribute movement. Monitor both the joint and long-baseline element elevations to distinguish these contributions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-baseline settlement, four-corner opening and joint shear movement. If one normal opening measurement conceals corner differences and rotation-induced local unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心~Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact
units.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心~Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact

Average bearing requires a known effective area; edge contact introduces splitting and local bending. The whole visible face is not automatically active bearing area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 分區滲漏與來源辨識~Compartment leakage and source diagnosis
units.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識~Compartment leakage and source diagnosis
units.mechanism: 接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。比較分區壓力與時間響應可縮小來源，總流量還受外水位影響；低流量不能證明兩重屏障均保持完整。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化；若出現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. Outlet location alone does not locate the breach. Compartment pressure and time response narrow the source, while external water level affects total flow; low flow does not demonstrate two intact barriers. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. units.anchor: 應力鬆弛與長期密封~Stress relaxation and long-term sealing
units.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封~Stress relaxation and long-term sealing
units.mechanism: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。短期保持率只是特定試驗條件的比較，不是現場壽命或剩餘承壓能力；長期評估需保持幾何變形與材料劣化資料之間的對應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移；若出現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. Short-term retention compares specified test conditions, not field lifetime or remaining pressure capacity. Long-term assessment must link material degradation evidence with actual geometric deformation histories. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案~Barrier independence and handover records
units.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案~Barrier independence and handover records
units.mechanism: 主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。交接需對應各屏障試驗、幾何、材料和可檢查部位，完整率僅顯示證據缺口；缺失一項關鍵試驗不能由更多非關鍵紀錄補足。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單；若出現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement. Handover links separate barrier tests, geometry, materials and accessible locations. Record completeness reveals evidence gaps; many minor records cannot compensate for a missing critical barrier test. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查端面姿態與初始接觸：differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm；再獨立檢查主密封壓縮與反力曲線：compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40。角差從 0.0005 增至 0.0008 rad，使 30 m 寬面上的幾何差由 15 增至 24 mm，增加六成；反力不一定同比。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 將同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check End-face attitude and initial contact: differential=width*angle=30 m*0.0005 rad=0.015 m=15 mm. Independently check Primary-seal compression and reaction curves: compressionRatio=closure/profileHeight=40 mm/100 mm=0.40. Increasing angular mismatch from 0.0005 to 0.0008 rad raises the differential across a 30 m face from 15 to 24 mm, a sixty-percent increase; reaction need not scale proportionally. The two results are not a complete design because joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. Use record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的沉管接頭幾何、壓縮接觸與雙重水密屏障，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。費馬恩業主公開工廠、溝槽與管節施工脈絡，深中通道則列於密封製造商案例；兩者僅作工法與界面比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on immersed-joint geometry, compression contact and dual sealing barriers reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Femern describes factory, trench and element interfaces, while the seal manufacturer lists the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. They are method and interface comparisons only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
